rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ The Big Bang was an explosion in space. ✅ The Big Bang was the BEGINNING of space and time itself. There was no pre-existing space into which the universe exploded. Space, time, matter, and energy all came into existence together.  ·  ❌ Hubble's law applies to all galaxies in the same way. ✅ Hubble's law $v = H_0 d$ applies to galaxies that are not gravitationally bound to each other. Galaxies within the same cluster can have peculiar velocities that deviate from the Hubble flow.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: ❌ Redshift means galaxies are moving through space away from us. ✅ Cosmological redshift is caused by the EXPANSION OF SPACE ITSELF. Galaxies are at rest in their local frame; space expands and stretches the wavelength of light as it travels.  ·  ❌ The universe was always expanding at the current rate. ✅ The expansion rate has changed dramatically over cosmic history. In the early universe, expansion was decelerating due to gravity; around 4 billion years ago, dark energy began to dominate and expansion began accelerating.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: The cosmic microwave background was discovered accidentally by Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson in 1965 while working on radio communications. They received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1978. The CMB is the most perfect black body in nature, matching Planck's law to extraordinary precision.  ·  The 2011 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Perlmutter, Schmidt, and Riess for the 1998 discovery of the accelerating expansion of the universe — implying that ~68% of the universe consists of dark energy. This was one of the most shocking discoveries in cosmology.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Big Bang theory:** The prevailing cosmological model describing the origin and evolution of the universe. The universe began approximately 13.8 billion years ago from an extremely hot, dense initial state — the Big Bang singularity — and has been expanding and cooling ever since. All matter, energy, space, and time originated from this event.  ·  **Hubble's law:** The recessional velocity $v$ of a galaxy is directly proportional to its distance $d$ from an observer: $v = H_0 d$. This linear relationship is the observational cornerstone of an expanding universe. The constant of proportionality $H_0$ is the Hubble constant, currently measured as $H_0 \approx 70\,\text{km/s/Mpc}$.  ·  **Hubble parameter and time:** The Hubble time $t_H = 1/H_0 \approx 14$ billion years gives an approximate age of the universe. This is consistent with the independently measured age of 13.8 billion years from the cosmic microwave background.

It is not from the initial explosion but from the state of the universe at recombination.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ❌ Dark energy and dark matter are the same thing. ✅ Dark matter (27%) interacts gravitationally but not electromagnetically. Dark energy (68%) is a property of space itself causing accelerated expansion. They are completely different phenomena with different effects.  ·  ❌ The Hubble constant has been measured precisely and is not changing. ✅ $H_0$ (the current value) is measured precisely (~70 km/s/Mpc), but the Hubble parameter $H(t)$ varies with cosmic time. Dark energy causes $H(t)$ to decrease at first, then stabilize as dark energy dominates.  ·  Note 3: Practice numerical problems regularly for mastery of Universe: Big Bang and Hubble law — expansion of the Universe
